name: lizardman_ranger
description: a Lizardman Ranger (Fall from Heaven), a green-scaled lizardman with a long snout and an orange crest under a leafy green hooded cloak, orange cloth wraps on the arms and an orange loincloth, brown leather leg wraps, clawed green feet, a quiver of white-fletched arrows on his back, a brown hawk perched on his screen-left shoulder, a green tail with orange spines sweeping out behind him to the lower-left, and a wooden longbow held out in his LEFT hand with an arrow nocked and drawn back to his cheek by his RIGHT hand
hands: the longbow stays in his left hand on the screen-right side, held out at arm's length; his right hand on the screen-left side draws the string and arrow back to his cheek

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the right hand flung out to the left, still clutching the arrow, the bow arm thrown up and out with the longbow upright), the hawk on his shoulder flapping
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the longbow dipping, the right hand still held out with the arrow, the tail swishing

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, bow arm flung up with the longbow upright, the arrow falling from the right hand, the brown hawk flapping up off his shoulder
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, hooded head droops, the longbow lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, one end of the longbow resting on the ground at the lower-right, the right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the longbow slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the tail sweeping out along the ground
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the leafy hood still on; the longbow lies on the ground at the lower-right; the quiver under his shoulders, a few arrows spilled
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the leafy cloak settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the longbow on the ground beside him, the brown hawk standing on the ground by his head
